description: Secteurs d'intervention des unités de la Direction de la Voirie en charge de la propreté des voies publiques de Rennes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole en accès libre. This layer of polygons makes it possible to know the areas of intervention of the teams of the Directorate of Clean Roads and Holidays in charge of the cleanliness of public roads. Each unit is attached to a team (see UUID metadata = 76317e99-3d65-454a-a197-ecd95a5bc2ca). Coverage: Rennes Métropole en accès libre. The portal shows the English title as "Areas of intervention of the units of the Directorate of Roads in charge of the cleanliness of the public roads of Renne" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Its keywords include proprete, environnement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-07-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
